# `operations.aug`

<a id="symbol-exercise"></a>
## `exercise` · [source](operations.aug#L4)

Run inside the worker; no native handle or parent service crosses heaps. It takes `configuration` as a string. Failures can raise `IndexError` and [`PostgresError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/contracts.aug.md#symbol-PostgresError).

It sets `storage` to a [`NativeDatabaseStorage`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-NativeDatabaseStorage). It calls [`storage.open`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-NativeDatabaseStorage.open) with `configuration`, `maximum` `1`, `connectMilliseconds` `2000`, and `cleanupMilliseconds` `100` and stores the result in owned `pool` ([`Pool`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Pool)). With temporary permission to change `pool`, it calls [`acquire`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-acquire) with `pool` and stores the result in owned `connection` ([`Connection`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Connection)). With temporary permission to change `connection`, it calls [`query`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-query) with `connection`, `sql` `"CREATE TEMP TABLE example (id int PRIMARY KEY, body bytea)"`, `parameters` from a list with no items, `milliseconds` `1000`, `maximumRows` `10`, and `maximumBytes` `1048576` and stores the result in owned `created` ([`Result`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Result)).

It calls [`query`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-query) with `connection`, `sql` `"INSERT INTO example VALUES (1, $1::bytea)"`, `parameters` from a list containing `"\\x00017fff80"`, `milliseconds` `1000`, `maximumRows` `10`, and `maximumBytes` `1048576` and stores the result in owned `inserted` ([`Result`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Result)). It calls [`query`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-query) with `connection`, `sql` `"SELECT body FROM example WHERE id=$1::int"`, `parameters` from a list containing `"1"`, `milliseconds` `1000`, `maximumRows` `10`, and `maximumBytes` `1048576` and stores the result in owned `result` ([`Result`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Result)). If [`rows`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-rows) with `result` does not equal `1` or `hex` on [`bytes`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-bytes) with `result`, `row` `0`, and `column` `0` does not equal `"00017fff80"`, it raises a [`PostgresError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/contracts.aug.md#symbol-PostgresError) with `code` `-1` and `message` `"Bytea result differs"`.

It calls [`query`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-query) with `connection`, `sql` `"INSERT INTO example VALUES (1, NULL)"`, `parameters` from a list with no items, `milliseconds` `1000`, `maximumRows` `10`, and `maximumBytes` `1048576` and stores the result in owned `duplicate` ([`Result`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/bindings.aug.md#symbol-Result)). It raises a [`PostgresError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/contracts.aug.md#symbol-PostgresError) with `code` `-1` and `message` `"Unique constraint was not enforced"`. If this work raises [`PostgresError`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/contracts.aug.md#symbol-PostgresError) as `error`, it if [`sqlState`](.aug-spec/packages/%40greenpandastudios/aug-postgres/0.1.0/api.aug.md#symbol-sqlState) with `error` does not equal `"23505"`, it raises `error`. It returns `"PostgreSQL native worker passed"`.
